pipeline_metric_semantics.read_ms: wall time from launch to final storage completion; overlaps CRC and H2D
pipeline_metric_semantics.crc_ms: sum of host record-validation work intervals
pipeline_metric_semantics.h2d_ms: host H2D submission time plus final synchronization wait; not full DMA duration
pipeline_metric_semantics.read_cpu_ms: compatibility field: process CPU until all CRC and H2D submissions complete; not isolated read CPU
pipeline_metric_semantics.total_ms: launch through final CUDA stream synchronization; primary endpoint
